description: This file defines API routes for interacting with user sessions and dataset status in the VoltSurge demo application. It includes route handlers for retrieving or creating a session and checking dataset payload status, utilizing FastAPI's routing and dependency injection features.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Data model representing session information including session ID and timestamps.

classes.name: DatasetStatusResponse
classes.description: Data model representing the status of a dataset payload for a session.

methods.name: str _ensure_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Ensures a session exists for the client, creating one if necessary, and sets a session cookie.

methods.name: SessionInfo get_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None))
methods.description: Route handler that retrieves or creates a session, returning session information.

methods.name: DatasetStatusResponse get_dataset_status(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None))
methods.description: Route handler that returns the dataset payload status and a preview for the current session.

ctags.name: get_session
ctags.pattern: /^def get_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None)) -> Sess/
